body.text:
Assistente de Plantão — como usar:
• Fale ou escreva do jeito que for mais rápido: áudio, texto ou foto.
• Sempre diga o nome e o ID do paciente (e o leito, se tiver): pode haver mais de um com o mesmo nome.
• "novo paciente" — mostra um modelo para internação nova.
• "pendências" — lista o que é seu e está aberto.
• "feito 3" — conclui a pendência 3.
• "adiar 3 30" ou "adiar 3 1h" — adia a pendência 3.
• "ok nota <token>" — confirma a revisão exata apresentada.
• "corrigir <texto>" — refaz a última nota com o texto certo.
O assistente não grava no HIS: ele devolve o texto pronto para você colar lá.

body.text:
Assistente de Plantão — como usar:
• Fale ou escreva do jeito que for mais rápido: áudio, texto ou foto.
• Sempre diga o nome e o ID do paciente (e o leito, se tiver): pode haver mais de um com o mesmo nome.
• "novo paciente" — mostra um modelo para internação nova.
• "pendências" — lista o que é seu e está aberto.
• "feito 3" — conclui a pendência 3.
• "adiar 3 30" ou "adiar 3 1h" — adia a pendência 3.
• "ok nota <token>" — confirma a revisão exata apresentada.
• "corrigir <texto>" — refaz a última nota com o texto certo.
O assistente não grava no HIS: ele devolve o texto pronto para você colar lá.

limitations: ACCEPT applies only to the exact 129-input compiled consumer artifact and reviewed containment settings. It grants no unrestricted production, clinical/HIS, financial, appointment, provider, release or D1-D4 approval.

This is a fresh bundle replacement on an existing shellless Node22 rootfs. The original Dockerfile was not rebuilt; upstream rootfs/toolchain provenance, image supply-chain attestation, vulnerabilities and full-build reproducibility were not qualified.
network=none and actual loopback-only observations are container evidence. No host nft policy was read, changed or certified; image configuration alone does not impose these Docker run constraints.
The image bundle is owned by10001 with mode0664. Runtime rootfs read-only enforces immutability in these probes; an unconstrained writable deployment would not inherit that protection.

Default NO_MODEL means no modelHost is injected into the real entrypoint. Loopback mock captured zero model/Whisper calls during tested text flows; model inference, approved model-host injection, audio/photo, cost budgets and real external providers were not exercised.

Only synthetic WAHA-shaped transport responses were used. provider_accepted is transport acceptance; no real delivery callback, clinical action or provider delivery qualification is established. Health reports deliveryQualification NOT_QUALIFIED.

Recovery evidence covers graceful Docker stop/start and complete source-message replay with one raw draft/confirmation, plus corrupt complete-journal fail-closed and exclusive-writer refusal. Crash/power-loss, nondelimited-tail recovery, long-running/load/concurrency stress and arbitrary replay interleavings remain untested.

Public-dist byte equality and byte-identical esbuild reproduction do not prove TypeScript-to-public-dist regeneration or whole-repository/native R26 qualification. Native R26 in R25 was neither read nor invoked; whole R25/source cleanliness is outside scope.

Before/after preservation covers 516 expressly enumerated relevant files, not every file on the host. No shared Root governance, private env, real keys/data, PG, prior critic judgments, producer smoke outcomes or subagents were used.

Required synthetic configuration contains a loopback-only API-key placeholder and synthetic webhook secret, not real credentials. All application/mocks used only container loopback18432/18433/18434; prohibited ports were never bound or contacted.

harnessCorrection.initialAttempt: Synthetic member list omitted a required manager; compiled startup correctly failed closed. Initial attempt logs/commands were preserved as initial-no-manager-*; fixture then gained a synthetic manager. This was a review fixture correction, no producer/source change.

report.nextAction: No review work remains for this scope. Broader qualification requires separately authorized evidence for the listed limits.
